title: Plumbing Repair Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Plumbing Repair: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Plumbing Repair Estimate Worksheet covers fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish. The plumbing service coordinator records Residential Plumbing Repair observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Plumbing Repair Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Plumbing Repair exceptions visible until the plumbing service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Plumbing Repair Estimate Worksheet at residence, room, fixture, shutoff point, and affected downstream area. Document fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish identity before Residential Plumbing Repair begins. Compare fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish findings with stated Residential Plumbing Repair criteria; route unresolved Residential Plumbing Repair issues to qualified plumbing service reviewer. For Plumbing Repair Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Residential Plumbing Repair. Ask qualified plumbing service reviewer to review Residential Plumbing Repair conditions beyond the plumbing service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Property estimate review and customer identity
sections.guidance: Identify the customer, asset or property, estimator, and basis date before pricing the work.

blocks.label: Residential Plumbing Repair identity

fields.label: Fixture, line, valve, appliance, or drain identifier
Leak or blockage onset, usage condition, and prior repair

blocks.guidance: Use the Residential Plumbing Repair identifier printed on fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish or its linked source record.

sections.title: Pricing options and customer decision inputs
sections.guidance: Price the observable work and options. Keep concealed conditions and unconfirmed quantities out of fixed scope.

blocks.label: Residential Plumbing Repair scope observations
items: Active leak location, rate, and affected materials
Supply pressure, shutoff, valve, and connection condition
Drain flow, backup, trap, vent, and cleanout observation
Fixture mounting, seal, and functional behavior
Water-heating or appliance connection where in scope
Post-repair leak, flow, and drainage test
blocks.guidance: Mark what was observed or supplied as estimate input; explain anything material that could not be inspected.

sections.title: Estimate exception and change conditions
sections.guidance: State what could change the price, timing, method, or scope before the customer or responsible party decides.

blocks.label: Conditions that may require a revised estimate or specialist review
items: Uncontrolled water flow or contamination concern
Concealed damage or mold-like condition outside scope
Gas, electrical, structural, or utility conflict
Repair requires unavailable shutdown or authority
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Plumbing Repair and notify plumbing service coordinator when water control, contamination, concealed damage, utility conflict, or safe test remains unresolved.

sections.title: Estimate decision and selected service scope
sections.guidance: Record the selected option and spending limit. Approval of an estimate authorizes only the stated scope and terms.

blocks.label: Estimate support retained
blocks.guidance: Attach or link proof for fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish; mark only Residential Plumbing Repair evidence present in that record.
